extracted.intended_audience: readers of The New York Times and newspaper editorial/layout staff
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and examples for arranging and styling a newspaper front page (headlines, subheads, by-lines, sections) to achieve effective visual composition and editorial clarity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principles of Make-Up
rubrics_metrics.description: PRINCIPLES OF MAKE-UP — Symmetrical balance. A varying treatment of the headlines results in a slightly subheads, in relation to the body type.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note the style of the by-lines, the special dispatch lines and the (visual) treatment — use symmetrical balance and vary headline treatment so subheads relate appropriately to body type. (This entry is drawn from the page's 'PRINCIPLES OF MAKE-UP' note and accompanying typography/layout comments.)
